report.explanation: Only gateway telemetry is available. A single gateway trace shows a 909ms ERROR calling order, but gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 79ms, and logs show a 200 ok, contradicting a gateway-wide fault. No order, payment, inventory, or postgres telemetry exists to bound a downstream cause, so no evidence-supported candidate can be stated.
